title: What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in August
excerpt: Traveling to Ninh Binh in August, visitors are amazed by the beauty of lotus flowers exuding a fragrant scent as the weather gradually turns to autumn, and visiting the scenic spots of Tam Coc, Bich Dong, Thung Nham bird garden, Cuc Phuong
html:
Traveling to Ninh Binh in August, visitors are amazed by the beauty of lotus flowers exuding a fragrant scent as the weather gradually turns to autumn, and visiting the scenic spots of Tam Coc, Bich Dong, Thung Nham bird garden, Cuc Phuong national park, Bai Dinh pagoda… visitors can admire the scenery in the autumn weather, there is nothing more beautiful. So let’s take a look at What is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in August below.

Ninh Binh is a destination that is attracting domestic and international tourists. When traveling Ninh Binh in August, visitors will be amazed by the beauty of lotus season, lotus flowers exuding a passionate fragrance. Visitors can take pictures of the fragrant lotus season. To admire the beauty of this place in August, let’s take a look at the beautiful things about Ninh Binh in August below.

The weather in Ninh Binh in August is not as hot and sunny as in summer. In August, Ninh Binh enters the autumn season with a relatively cool climate, the sky is clear, sometimes there are clouds drifting, and occasionally there are sudden showers, so when traveling to Ninh Binh in August, you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect your sightseeing itinerary.

Visiting Trang An in August

Trang An has long been a popular tourist destination, where the green mountains and blue water blend together to create a poetic picture.

In particular, when traveling to Trang An, tourists also visit mysterious caves, rich fauna, shimmering and magical water valleys, and many historical relics including temples, shrines, and ancient pagodas from thousands of years ago that still remain today.

Thach Bich – Thung Nang

Coming to Thach Bich – Thung Nang in August, the weather is in autumn, with cool breezes, and the rice fields are starting to turn yellow, next to the blue rivers. When the sun just rises, the rays of sunlight shine through the leaves, or next to the rustic thatched houses located right on the river, creating a poetic picture, inside are caves surrounded by undulating mountains, a fascinating beauty.

Tam Coc – Bich Dong

Located in the Trang An scenic area, Tam Coc has 3 main caves: Hang Ca, Hang Hai, Hang Ba… to get here, visitors can sit on a dugout canoe along the river =, on both sides are long rice fields, Tam Coc has a truly poetic scene.

If you are a person who loves to admire the natural scenery of clouds and sky, you can rent a bicycle to go sightseeing, the destination that tourists cannot miss when traveling to Tam Coc is Bich Dong Pagoda, only 3km from Tam Coc, on both sides of the road to the pagoda are blooming lotus ponds giving off a cool fragrance, traveling to Tam Coc – Bich Dong in August, visitors will enjoy the charming beauty of the ancient capital.

Hang Mua

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ninh Binh tour, when coming here, visitors will visit the ancient fortress, and conquer 500 stone steps, but in return, visitors will fully admire the beauty of Ninh Binh from above, and record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Thung Nham Bird Garden

August Thung Nham Bird Garden is very beautiful, in the cool weather, visitors can feast their eyes on the beauty, or take pictures of the lotus flowers spreading their fragrance in the wind, or enjoy a cup of lotus tea watching the peaceful scenery, enjoying the cool breeze, there is nothing more interesting. Besides, visitors also visit caves such as Hang But, inside there are beautiful stone slabs, which will bring visitors unforgettable memories when visiting Ninh Binh.

So it can be said that when traveling to Ninh, no matter what season of the year, visitors can feel its own beauty, a charming landscape of mountains and rivers, with vast rice fields, or the fragrant lotus season, or watching flocks of birds flying in the sky, especially going by boat to visit mysterious caves. Especially foreign tourists when traveling to Ninh Binh also experience cycling to see the scenery or enjoy fragrant lotus tea and delicious dishes that attract customers will bring tourists the most unforgettable vacation in Ninh Binh.
